transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Good morning, Brighton Language Centre. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: Hello. I'm interested in an English course for the summer. I'm in Brighton from July, and I'd like to study for about a month.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: We have several options. The general English course is three hours every morning, Monday to Friday. There's also an intensive course with afternoon classes as well.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: The general course is two hundred and fifty pounds a week. The intensive course is three hundred and eighty.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: That's a big difference. I think the general course is enough. I want time to visit places in the afternoon.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: That makes sense. When would you like to start? The next courses begin on the fifth of July and the nineteenth of July.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I arrive on the third, so the fifth would be perfect. Is it possible to study for four weeks?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Yes. Four weeks would be one thousand pounds in total. Actually, if you pay for four weeks together, we give you ten per cent off, so it would be nine hundred pounds.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: That's very good. What about accommodation? Can you arrange it?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Yes, we can. You can stay with a local family. It's a hundred and ten pounds a week, including breakfast and dinner. Or there's a student house for ninety pounds a week without meals.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: I'd prefer a family, because I want to practise my English. Is there a family near the school?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Most of our families live within twenty minutes by bus. I'll find you one close to the number seven bus route.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: Great. Do I need to take a test before the course?

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Yes, there's a short online test so we can put you in the right class. I'll send you the link by email, so please give me your address on the booking form.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: Of course. I'll write it on the form.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Perfect. You'll get the link today, and please complete the test before the twenty-fifth of June.

transcript.speaker: S2
transcript.text: Thank you very much. I'll do it this week.
